answer: A sybil farm of N fake agents pays N times the burn plus forfeits every cedar bond on detection, while honest single agents pay once. Agents stake a cedar-bonded deposit locked to a hardware-attested identity, and each epoch they must burn a velvet token whose cost scales with the number of identities they operate. Reputation scores are hashed onto a shale ledger, so cloning an identity resets its score to zero, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0200's threat model.
